description: Step 4/6: no first-sync state. After 'Connecting…' the card jumps to 'Synced 42 meetings, 3 minutes ago'; the first-sync-running and '0 meetings so far' states are not drawn, so Maya cannot tell if 42 is complete or a first batch.
expected: A visible in-progress state during the 90-day backfill, then a final count.
actual: Only the finished 'Synced {n} meetings, {time}' line exists.
suggested_fix: Add one in-progress line (for example 'Syncing, {n} so far') or define that the card shows nothing until the first batch lands.

description: Step 5: journey breaks, no surface tells Maya the Granola agent now exists or links to it. The Connected card has only the status line and Disconnect.
expected: A link to the agent (as McpDetail shows today) or the agent already visible with a pointer.
actual: Connected card: status line and Disconnect only.
suggested_fix: Reuse the existing IntegrationAgentSection link on the key card.

description: Detail page (and 390px spot-check) shows two identically labelled red 'Disconnect' buttons once the key is connected (Live questions and Sync) with no scope in the label. Screen 2 draws the Sync card alone, so the pair is never drawn together.
expected: One Disconnect per route with a label that names what it disconnects, or a single place.
suggested_fix: Draw both connected together; label by route or merge the two sections.
plan_section: granola.md S6 (page order, discovery ambiguity 6/7); catalog Duplicate paths 1

description: Tile and detail use 'Live questions' and 'Sync · Business plan' as section labels. A first-time user does not know that 'Sync' is the route that gives Inbox to-dos, and the tile button 'Add key' does not say what a key is for.
expected: Labels that say what each route gives (stored meetings, to-dos) without extra explainer text.
actual: Two jargon labels, no benefit stated.
suggested_fix: Rename 'Sync' to what it provides, or reveal the benefit only when the key field is focused.

description: Mockup tile and sidebar show Granola 'Connected' for Live questions and a 'Granola agent' already in the sidebar, but GS-1's persona has never connected Granola. The first-time state (tile unconnected, no agent) is not drawn.
expected: Tile in its unconnected state, no agent in the sidebar.
actual: MCP route pre-connected on every screen.
suggested_fix: Add an unconnected tile state, or say in the walk catalog that the MCP route is assumed connected.

description: Step 9: GS-1's user has mail with triage on (To do on the Important pile), but the Inbox mockup draws the meeting-only layout ('no mail account'). The mail + meeting Inbox is not drawn for this story (IF-2 not mocked).
expected: The Inbox as a mail user sees it, with the To do card on the Important pile.
actual: Meeting-only Inbox, no mail rows or piles.
suggested_fix: Add a state with the mail pile tabs above the To do card.

description: Disabled 'Connect' renders as a mid-grey solid button with dark text in dark mode, which looks more enabled than disabled.
suggested_fix: Use a border-only or muted disabled style.

expected: Label and badge on one line.
